sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
SUMMARY
Senior mobile and frontend engineer with 10+ years shipping React Native and React.js products end-to-end, with 7 apps released to the App Store and Google Play. Sole developer on multiple production client codebases, including a white-label React Native platform serving 4 client brands and an enterprise Next.js account. Built the frontend of an internal LLM/RAG document platform on Pinecone vector search. Track record of picking up unfamiliar stacks fast — moved from .NET to React, web to React Native, and learned Vue.js in a week to deliver a client prototype. Also lead teams, but happiest with significant hands-on ownership.
TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS
Shipped 7 mobile apps to the App Store and Google Play, owning the process end-to-end from architecture through release across both iOS and Android workflows
Architected a white-label React Native codebase producing 4 independently branded client apps, with full Bitrise CI/CD for per-brand builds, code signing, and store releases
Built the conversational frontend for an LLM/RAG document platform using Pinecone vector search and multi-workspace document isolation
Eliminated performance bottlenecks on a production banking app through dependency auditing, app/bundle size reduction, memoization, and list virtualization

SELECTED PROJECTS
LOGIT — Logistics Management Platform (React, Node.js, React Native) — Admin web app for orders, shipments, positions, cargo item counts, and invoicing, plus a dedicated driver mobile app for shipment entry and working-hours logging synced to the same backend. Technical lead / EM from kickoff. White-Label Mobile Platform (React Native, Bitrise) — Single React Native codebase producing 4 independently branded client apps, with per-brand configuration and automated Bitrise build and store-release pipelines. Sole developer and architect. DMS — LLM Document Platform (React.js, Node.js, Pinecone) — Document platform where uploads are embedded into Pinecone vector storage and queried conversationally through LLM retrieval, with isolated multi-workspace access. Built the chat frontend and led the project. Content Management Platform (React Native, React.js, Node.js) — Mobile app plus web admin backend for publishing blogs, posts and events, with user management, in-app purchases, embedded video streaming, and course delivery. Built both tiers. Prudential Bank Mobile App (React Native) — Health assessment via photo capture returning BMI and body-fat metrics, food diet planner, calorie tracker, and OCR document capture, alongside a full UI/UX and performance optimization pass. Kreuzworträtsel — Crossword Puzzle App (React Native, TypeScript, NativeWind) — Shipped to both iOS and Android app stores with real- time game logic, analytics, and full release ownership. Live: App Store | Google Play Konica Minolta (Next.js) — Enterprise digital experience built with SSG and ISR for SEO and load-speed gains. Sole developer.
